items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: he had borrowed from a man named Lee Bowles

ctx.x: Then did he give up his trumpet for a while and stop music?

No he played for a while he had old battle horn he had borrowed from a man named Lee Bowles. That's when he would play with Gus Fontenet and then we couldn't get him a nine thing. And then after that he would, him and his uncle Hendry. Your Bunk's uncle? Yeah.
What was his last name? Johnson's anywhere about it?
